final.text:
What ships

macOS 26 and later: AppIcon.icon (Icon Composer). Light and dark colours per layer; tinted and clear use white head and bar with the history stepping down. The system draws every size from the 1024 master, because .icon has no per-size variants.

macOS 14 and 15: the AppIcon.icns that actool renders from the same .icon.

The hand-tuned small cut (rings become dots, strokes thicken) ships in the exported PNGs and design/logo/final/AppIcon.icns. Xcode ignores an appiconset when an .icon of the same name exists, so the app itself doesn't use the cut.

Polish over the picked direction: equal gaps between nodes, mark centred on the body, older bars a step brighter, all shapes outlined (no strokes).

rec.text:
Decision (2026-10-31): 04 Log. The append-only, hash-chained history drawn like a commit graph; the head op is a checked task.

Earlier recommendation, kept for the record:

1. 06 Cursor. The boldest silhouette at 16pt and nobody else's shape. A check followed by a block cursor says "done, and ready for the next one", and the cursor blue is Rex's accent.

2. 07 Gap. The insertion line with its ring from drag-to-reorder: the most "this app" detail. Below 60pt it drops the row contents so it doesn't read as a menu glyph.

Watch-outs: 01 Row can read as a toggle switch at 16pt. 02 Split is close to the system sidebar glyph. 05 Tile's letter follows the working name. 03 Rise leans towards weather apps.

Every mark has a small-size cut: below 60pt it drops hairlines and thickens strokes (see the 32 and 16).
